The '''ro-roo''' was a small, [[Diet|herbivorous]] [[Primate/Legends|primate]] that was native to the [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|wroshyr tree]] forests of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. Ro-roo [[Limb/Legends|paws]] were often used as good luck amulets.<ref name="SWG:RotW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ro-roos were included as creatures in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']] with the release of the [[2005]] expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']],<ref name="SWG:RotW" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Ro-roos are also mentioned in a deleted scene from the [[2018]] [[canon]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''&mdash;Deleted Scene: "Han Versus Chewie: Extended"</ref>
